description: AC drive for industrial applications, 200 V, 400 V and 6-phase 400 V class, MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU on the built-in RS-485 port
source: YASKAWA GA800 Drive Technical Reference, SIEPC71061737G, section 6.3 and chapter 11

sources.title: YASKAWA GA800 Drive Technical Reference
sources.note: section 6.3 (tables 6.2, 6.5, 6.13 and 6.15 to 6.19) and the parameter list (A1, b1, C1, C6, d1, E1, E2, H5, o1, U1-U4)

notes: MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU: 8 data bits and 1 stop bit (fixed). Factory defaults are node address 0x1F (31), 9600 bps (H5-02 = 3) and no parity (H5-03 = 0); after changing them, power cycle or set H5-20 = 1.
The drive supports function codes 03 (read, at most 16 registers), 08 (loopback), 10 (write, at most 16 registers), 5A and 67. It has no function 06: write single registers with function 10.

To run from Modbus set b1-01 = 2 and b1-02 = 2. With H5-11 = 0 (default) a parameter write takes effect only after the Enter command: write 0 to 0x0900 (saved to EEPROM) or 0x0910 (RAM only). Command data (0x0001-0x001F, 0x15C0, 0x15DF) needs no Enter command.

Frequency registers are scaled for o1-03 = 0 (0.01 Hz), the default for induction motors. With A1-02 = 6 or 7 (PM motors) the drive sets o1-03 = 1 (0.01 % of E1-04). Some current and power registers change resolution with the drive model; their scale is left at 1.
Only the main parameters are listed. Every parameter has its MEMOBUS address in the manual's parameter list (chapter 11): read it with function 03 and write it as above.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
